Done! I've enabled Partial Pre-rendering (PPR) in your Next.js config at `next.config.ts:4-6`.

With PPR enabled, you can now:
- Wrap dynamic sections in `<Suspense>` boundaries 
- Static parts will be pre-rendered at build time
- Dynamic parts will stream in at runtime

The parts of your pages outside Suspense will be statically generated, while Suspense-wrapped sections will be dynamically rendered.

content.text:
Done! I've enabled Partial Pre-rendering (PPR) in your Next.js config at `next.config.ts:4-6`.

With PPR enabled, you can now:
- Wrap dynamic sections in `<Suspense>` boundaries 
- Static parts will be pre-rendered at build time
- Dynamic parts will stream in at runtime

The parts of your pages outside Suspense will be statically generated, while Suspense-wrapped sections will be dynamically rendered.
